77472.subject: 💰 Siri is about to start paying for content
77472.body:
----------
######                  [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/he2t9cz)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Apple wants to pay publishers every time Siri borrows their words, the first AI company to offer paying by the use instead of a flat fee. Google halved the price of its newest model, OpenAI's revenue chief walked out days after its COO, and Amazon started training AI on Twitch streamers unless they dig into settings and switch it off.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Apple:** Why will it pay every time you ask Siri?

* **Google:** What did it just cut in half?

* **OpenAI:** Who walked out days before the IPO?

* **Amazon:** What is it taking from Twitch by default?


----------



----------
## Apple will pay the news every time Siri uses it

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e04a38b7-7cae-4206-825a-bbf56a15085f/Newsletter_14_Aug_-_1.jpg?t=1786686905)
Caption: 

Apple is [in talks to pay publishers](https://www.wsj.com/business/media/apple-in-talks-to-pay-publishers-to-improve-ai-powered-siri-0641f64b) for the content that will feed its new Siri, and the way it wants to pay is the real story. Instead of a flat licensing fee, Apple has floated paying each time Siri actually uses a publisher's work.

That pay-as-you-go model breaks the industry norm, where an AI company hands over one fixed sum for broad access to an archive. OpenAI's deal with News Corp was $250 million over five years. Apple would rather meter it.

The budget under discussion runs into nine figures, per the Wall Street Journal, and Apple has been reaching out to publishers for months.

It's a different posture from the rest of the field, which mostly trains on scraped work and settles the lawsuits later. Apple is offering to pay by the use before anyone sues.

The new Siri lands later this year. If it leans on the news as much as Apple expects, the meter starts running then.


----------







----------
## The AI profits went to people who got in early

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e26a5a49-9574-4bc5-881d-9318cfb80afd/ChatGPT_Image_Aug_7__2026__11_00_32_AM.png?t=1786089655)
Follow image link: (https://invest.genai.works/)
Caption: 

In 2019 Khosla Ventures put $50 million into OpenAI, which was then a research lab with no product and no revenue. That stake is worth billions now.

Recently, close to one in every two venture dollars went into AI, and the biggest outcomes went to people who were already inside before anyone agreed it was obvious.

GenAI
